d: Job Category Rooms & Guest Services Operations
Location Al Mouj, Muscat, OmanVIEW ON MAP

Greet and escort guests to rooms. Open doors and assist guests/visitors entering and leaving property. Inform guests of property amenities, services, and hours of operation, and local areas of interest and activities. Identify and explain room features to guests (e.g., use of room key, mini-bar, ice and vending areas, in-room safe, valet laundry services). Transport guest luggage to and from guest rooms and/or designated bell area. Assist with luggage storage and retrieval. Assist guests/visitors in and out of vehicles, including assisting guests with loading/unloading luggage. Supply guests with directions. Arrange transportation (e.g., taxicab, shuttle bus, limousine/sedan service) for guests/visitors, and record advance transportation request as needed. Communicate parking procedures to guests/visitors.

Follow all company policies and procedures, and report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager. Maintain awareness of undesirable persons on property premises. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional and maintain confidentiality of proprietary information. Welcome and acknowledge all guests, anticipate and address guests’ service needs, assist individuals with disabilities, and thank guests with genuine appreciation. Speak with others using clear and professional language, and answer telephones using appropriate etiquette. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others. Comply with quality assurance expectations and standards. Read and visually verify information in a variety of formats (e.g., small print). Move at a speed required to respond to work situations (e.g., run, walk, jog). Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time or for an entire work shift. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance and objects weighing in excess of 75 pounds with assistance. Move over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces as well as up and down stairs and/or service ramps. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.
q: Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.

d: Software Engineers & Code Owners – AI Code Licensing Program

Gramian is participating in an exclusive, invite-only code licensing program with a leading AI lab. The program allows software developers, engineers, and organizations to earn compensation by licensing existing software repositories for AI training and research purposes.
This is a non-exclusive licensing opportunity, meaning code owners retain their intellectual property and can continue using, maintaining, selling, or licensing their software elsewhere.
We are looking for high-quality, complete software projects, particularly in:
Legacy Systems (Highest Priority): COBOL, Fortran, JCL — ideally 10,000+ lines of production code from banking, insurance, or scientific systems. Retired systems are welcome.
Modern Development: Kotlin, OCaml, TypeScript, React, Next.js.
Game Development: Three.js, React Three Fiber, WebGL, Godot 4, Unity C#, Unreal C++, Phaser 3.
Valuation: $100/M of tokens of code and $40/M tokens of Git history (offline script available so you can run evaluations without entering the program)
No new development required — license your existing code.
Payments expected: Before Christmas 2026, or by January 21, 2027, if QA is delayed.
Future cohorts: Potential additional opportunities starting January 2027.
q: Private codebases only: Code must never have been publicly available, including on GitHub, GitLab, npm, or PyPI.
Human-written code: AI-generated code is not accepted. Projects developed before 2025 are preferred; newer projects require additional verification.
Code ownership: Applicants must own the code or have full licensing rights. Client-owned projects require written authorization.
Substantial, functional projects: Complete applications, SaaS platforms, backends, internal tools, or production systems. No basic templates, forks, WordPress projects, or code snippets.
Git history: Repositories should include original commit history, ideally with multiple contributors, pull requests, code reviews, issues, and tests.
Repository access: Code should be accessible directly through GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket for evaluation.
Bonus: Supporting project documentation, tickets, and development records may provide additional licensing opportunities.

Own growth-oriented product operations and strategy for the platform's core products, driving user trading through product mechanism optimization, content & community capabilities, segmentation, and personalized (1:1) product experiences and operating mechanisms — anchored on user lifecycle KPIs across signup, KYC, first deposit, first trade, active/repeat, dormancy, and winback.

Deep understanding of the user lifecycle and growth funnel, with the ability to design scalable operating mechanisms;
Strong data-driven decision making, with a track record of shipping into production;
Fluent English; able to drive execution in a global team environment;
Hands-on data analysis and A/B testing experience; clear reasoning and strong execution;
